note: Full unchanged measured compared input, no added/thinned coordinates. Normals k=24/up, SOR k=24/ratio=1.0; each method gets fresh contexts. Archived pre-prototype production output is a bit/PLY oracle. Current prepared CPU, CPU rounded block hints and physical GPU rounded block hints share one immutable prepared source and six counterbalanced execution orders. GPU hints are one u32 node per query. The CPU checks the block's original f64 points, obtains a safe k-th upper radius, and traverses the original exact tree in its historical order with strict subtree exclusions; final k-neighbour membership, tie order, PCA and SOR arithmetic stay authoritative on CPU. CPU hints use the identical rounded block walk and verifier without GPU submission/readback. Prepared original control shares retained optional bounds/GPU buffers after warm-up; no peak-memory reduction or isolated shader speedup is claimed. GPU buffers and exact bounds reuse are required after excluded setup; timed fallback fails. Whole RPC timings include hint transfer/readback, exact verification, joining and SOR output indexing. GPU phase time is host submission/readback time, not device timestamp execution. Validation/PLY export/removal, file loading, pool startup, first-use observations and five warm-up rounds are excluded. All results match archived normal bits/complete SOR PLY bytes. Input/source/manifest/script/source-code/both-build hashes are checked before and after. No builds/tests/scans run alongside timing; clocks, power, other applications, scheduling and GC remain uncontrolled. Even/odd source splits are workload geometry, not accuracy ground truth. GPU identifiers are limited to vendor/architecture/fallback status.
